actions.text: The EU's new AI framework is an important step toward accountability, but policymakers must balance safety with innovation. Clear risk tiers and proportionate compliance will help avoid stifling smaller developers while ensuring high-risk systems get rigorous oversight. Practical measures—such as regulatory sandboxes, standardized audit procedures, and shared test datasets—can reduce duplication and lower costs. Finally, international alignment on technical standards will prevent fragmentation and make it easier for companies to build compliant, trustworthy systems at scale.
